concerns.text: The plan reports a verified VIF of 33 (see Risks & Mitigations table) but does not propose any mitigation (e.g., removing/re‑parameterising collinear covariates). This violates SC‑005 (VIF < 5) and leaves the entropy coefficient potentially unstable due to multicollinearity.

Power is assessed only post‑hoc ("post‑hoc power analysis") rather than via an a priori calculation. Relying on post‑hoc power does not guarantee that the sample of 200 subjects is sufficient to detect the hypothesised effect size, undermining the study’s ability to meet SC‑006.

Entropy is averaged across scales 1‑5, discarding scale‑specific information. If the construct of neural complexity varies by temporal scale, this averaging may reduce construct validity of the predictor and obscure meaningful associations.

The statistical model assumes a linear relationship between DSRT scores and predictors (OLS). The plan does not verify that DSRT scores meet OLS assumptions (normality, homoscedasticity). If DSRT is skewed or bounded, a generalized linear model may be more appropriate.
